operations.description: Source reports running the reaction in both presence and absence of air with no observable product-property differences at that point. The cited oxidation by XPS is external reference17, not a current-study XPS measurement.

quality.review_scope: Independent R2 source audit of all three supplied main pages, four figures and the 18-entry bibliography passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete supplied three-page main, all four figures and bibliography entries 1–18 read; SI and cited full sources unreviewed.
Exact w = 3 charges and changes from the detailed w = 5 example are not reported. The w ratio is retained without calculating a water charge or silently copying w = 5 amounts.

TEM averages are based on only 21 and 28 particles for w = 3 and w = 5; distributions cannot be accurately reported because of agglomeration. Estimated average-size uncertainty is strictly less than 10%, not a measured standard deviation.
The source does not specify growth temperature, reactant-solution preparation, water partition or complete dropwise/air-control recipes. Ambient temperature is stated for the washing sonication only.
No measured atomic coordinates or numerical unit-cell parameters are supplied; thermoelectric performance is future work, not a measured current product property.
Independent source comparison and molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remain pending.
